title: Great tour!
text: Gonzalo was a wonderful guide. He shared great information, stories snd of course, arranged amazing tapas for us. It was everything we had hoped for and more. It was also very helpful that he met us at our hotel and walked us to the tour start. We could have taken a taxi but this was so much better. Thank you Gonzalo was making my group very happy!
author: jann711

title: Everything we hope for... And more
text: Excellent in All phases. He went out of his way to meet us after we got lost getting to the planned spot. Very well versed in history and extremely interesting points of view. And then there was the food... a great mix at some unique establishments, each with a story. Topped off with my favorite: thick, velvety, and warm dark chocolate & churros.Mmmm! It was everything we had hoped for.. and more.
author: dougv574

title: Amazing Food, History & Better Guide!
text:
Gonzalo was extremely knowledgeable and shared so much interesting history about Barcelona while also making the entire experience fun and relaxed. He was so friendly and personable that it honestly felt like we were just hanging out with a friend who happened to know everything about the city and its food.

The food was fantastic, the stories were great, and the whole experience was one of the highlights of our trip. I would definitely recommend Gonzalo to anyone visiting Barcelona.
